note: P4208 (Pro 23:2) — put a knife to your throat if you are given to appetite.

dims.v: gluttonous craving — to be checked as with a knife to the throat
the appetite/greed of the throat that, unchecked, endangers a man at the ruler's table — to be curbed as drastically as a knife held to the throat
the craving that self-control must violently curb

nephesh (appetite/throat/desire) — 'put a knife to your throat if you are given to APPETITE'; gluttonous craving must be checked with violent resolve. Where appetite rules, self-mastery must intervene sharply (cf 23:1).
